projects.title: Real-Time Object Detection System
projects.description: A high-performance object detection pipeline using YOLOv8 and OpenCV. Processes live camera feeds with sub-100ms latency, classifying 80+ object categories with 94% accuracy. Deployed on edge devices with optimized inference.

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis Engine
projects.description: End-to-end NLP pipeline for multi-class sentiment classification. Fine-tuned BERT model on custom dataset achieving 96% F1-score. REST API deployed via FastAPI with real-time inference capabilities.

projects.title: Predictive Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Machine learning-powered dashboard for business intelligence. Implements time-series forecasting with LSTM networks, anomaly detection, and automated report generation. Interactive visualizations built with Plotly.

timeline.description: Developed professional-grade AI projects including sentiment analysis engines and predictive dashboards. Building strong GitHub portfolio for global opportunities.
